This issue is PUBLIC. For suspected credential exposure or vulnerabilities use https://github.com/Chrominskyy/cloudlatch-site/security/advisories/new instead. Never post secrets, AWS identifiers, credential files or unredacted diagnostics.

## Impact
What stopped working? Which operation is affected? Describe scope without identifying accounts or people.

## Timeline
When did it start? Include timezone. Is it ongoing or resolved?

## Environment
CloudLatch version/build and macOS version, or affected public website URL.

## Symptoms and reproduction
Use sanitized messages and fictional identifiers.

## Workaround and recovery
What has been tried? Is there a safe workaround?

## Recent changes
Optional; omit private infrastructure details.
